about: Per-model OpenRouter provider pins. proxy.py adds `provider` = the pin's `provider` object to a call for that model, unless the client sent its own `provider`. Keys are model ids without a bench variant suffix (`@nojson`). A pin is a short ordered list of endpoints held equivalent for comparability: the same model, no quantization below the first endpoint's, and `allow_fallbacks: false`, so OpenRouter tries them in `order` and fails rather than going elsewhere. `only` repeats `order` so no other endpoint is eligible; `quantizations` (OpenRouter's filter: int4, int8, fp4, mxfp4, nvfp4, fp6, fp8, mxfp8, fp16, bf16, fp32, unknown; fp4 includes mxfp4 and nvfp4) leaves out any lower-precision endpoint, even one a listed provider adds later. A pin names the variant from the model's endpoint list (GET /api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints, `tag`): a full tag (`wafer/us`) matches only that endpoint; a base slug (`together`) matches all of that provider's endpoints except service-tier ones (`openai/fast`, `openai/flex`). `basis` records why each endpoint was picked. Change a pin here, not in code.

nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning.basis: full6: Fireworks served 2089 of 2114 calls (98.8%). Fireworks lists one endpoint for this model (`fireworks`). full6 did not record endpoint variants. full8 (pinned): Fireworks looped. Of its 2708 calls (engine and server ledgers), 271 stopped at max_tokens (finish_reason `length`, 10.0%; 258 of 2542 server calls) and 96 timed out, against 8 `length` in 2245 Fireworks calls in full6 (0.4%) and 7 in 486 in full7 (1.4%). Kept pinned: in full7 CoreWeave (26 `length` in 896), DeepInfra (42 in 705) and Io Net (7 in 328, median 21 s) did worse, and Darkbloom (0 in 293) took a median of 4.8 s.

openai/gpt-6-luna.basis: full6: OpenAI served 1913 of 2108 calls (90.7%). `openai` is the standard endpoint; the base slug does not select the `openai/flex` or `openai/fast` service tiers. full6 did not record which OpenAI endpoint served each call.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.basis: full8 pinned DeepSeek to `wafer/us` alone, and 94 of 2648 calls got a 429 (`temporarily rate-limited upstream`) under the parallel load. A second endpoint now takes those calls. Picked from full6 and full7 (engine and server ledgers, unpinned): only Wafer, Together and ModelRun had no bad call (non-200, error, or finish_reason `length`) in both. Wafer: 408 and 478 calls, median 1191 and 1425 ms on success. Together: 63 and 87 calls, median 908 and 789 ms. ModelRun (65 and 130 calls, median 2704 and 1691 ms) is slower and is left out. StepFun is left out too: 3 `length` in 173 calls in full6, though 0 in 286 in full7, at a median of 1239 and 1321 ms. Endpoint list on 2026-11-04: `wafer/us` reports `mxfp4`, the same as `wafer/mxfp4`; `together` is Together's only endpoint and reports `unknown`. `quantizations` therefore admits mxfp4 and everything above it, plus `unknown`, which Together needs; it leaves out int4, fp4 and nvfp4.
